verses.text: One whose mind is undisturbed in sorrow and unelated in joy, free from attachment, fear and anger, is truly steady in wisdom
Dwelling on the objects of the senses breeds attachment; from attachment desire is born, and from desire arises anger
From anger comes delusion, from delusion the loss of memory; when memory fails, discrimination is lost, and one falls
For those freed from desire and anger, with minds subdued and the Self realised, liberation is ever at hand
Fearlessness, purity of heart, self-restraint, truthfulness, freedom from anger, compassion and forgiveness are the marks of the divine nature
Lust, anger and greed are the three gates to ruin, destroyers of the self; therefore give up these three
Yield not to faint-heartedness, it does not befit you; shake off this weakness of heart and arise, O Arjuna
The contacts of the senses bring heat and cold, pleasure and pain; they come and go, so learn to bear them bravely
One unattached to outer pleasures, who finds joy within the Self, attains a happiness beyond measure
From goodness knowledge arises; from passion, greed; and from ignorance come negligence and delusion
Lust, anger and greed are the three gates to ruin, destroyers of the self; therefore give up these three
Those who seek liberation give, serve and sacrifice without any craving for reward
As a father forgives his son, a friend his friend, a lover the beloved, so please forgive me, O Lord
One who bears no ill will to any being, who is friendly, compassionate, free of ego and forgiving, is dear to Me
Fearlessness, purity of heart, self-restraint, truthfulness, freedom from anger, compassion and forgiveness are the marks of the divine nature
My mind is clouded about my duty; I am your student, take refuge in you, please instruct me
Your words bewilder me; tell me decisively the one path by which I may reach the highest good
The Lord dwells in the heart of every being, guiding all as they journey through this world
The wise look with equal vision upon the learned and the outcast, upon a cow, an elephant and a dog alike
Those whose minds rest in equanimity rise above all fault; they are already seated in the Supreme
One who sees all beings as equal to oneself, feeling their joy and sorrow as one's own, is the highest yogi
I am the same to all beings; none is hated or favoured by Me. Yet those who worship Me with love dwell in Me, and I in them
Do your appointed work, for action is better than inaction; even the body cannot be sustained without it
By performing their duties the ancients attained perfection; therefore you too should act
Yoga is not for one who eats too much or too little, nor for one who sleeps too much or too little
The happiness born of sleep, indolence and negligence, deluding from beginning to end, belongs to ignorance
Hypocrisy, arrogance, conceit, anger, harshness and ignorance belong to those of a demonic nature
'This I have gained, that I shall gain; I am the lord, I am the enjoyer, who is equal to me?' Thus the arrogant are deluded
One who acts free from ego and attachment, unshaken by success or failure, acts in purity
Fixing your mind on Me you will cross every difficulty by My grace; but if from pride you will not listen, you will be lost
One who bears no ill will to any being, who is friendly, compassionate, free of ego and forgiving, is dear to Me
Those who are hateful and cruel, lowest among humankind, are cast again and again into lower births
One who listens to this teaching with faith and without envy is freed and attains the blessed realms
Freed from attachment, fear and anger, absorbed in Me and purified by knowledge, many have attained My own being
Having shown His awesome form, Krishna returned to His gentle shape and consoled the frightened Arjuna
That understanding is pure which knows what to do and what to shun, what is to be feared and what is not, what binds and what frees
One who sees Me everywhere and sees all things in Me is never lost to Me, nor am I ever lost to them
I am the same to all beings; none is hated or favoured by Me. Yet those who worship Me with love dwell in Me, and I in them
Undivided yet appearing divided among beings, He stands outside and within all, sustaining everything
He is the light of all lights, beyond all darkness, seated in the heart of every being
For the unsteady there is no wisdom and no meditation; without meditation there is no peace, and without peace, where is happiness?
One who gives up all cravings, free from longing, ego and possessiveness, attains peace
One with faith and devotion, mastering the senses, gains wisdom, and through wisdom swiftly finds supreme peace
Knowing Me as the enjoyer of all offerings, the Lord of all worlds and the friend of every being, one attains peace
The yogi who knows this truth rises above all rituals and study, and reaches the supreme abode
As the soul passes through childhood, youth and old age, so it passes into another body; the wise do not grieve at this
The soul is never born and never dies; it is unborn, eternal and everlasting
As one casts off worn-out clothes and puts on new ones, so the soul lays aside a worn body and takes another
The soul is unseen, unthinkable and unchanging; knowing this, you have no cause to grieve
For the born, death is certain, and for the dead, birth is certain; do not mourn over what cannot be avoided
Even if you were the most sinful of all sinners, you would cross the ocean of sin in the boat of divine knowledge
As blazing fire turns wood to ashes, so the fire of knowledge burns all past deeds to ashes
One who offers every act to the Divine, free of attachment, is untouched by sin, as a lotus leaf is untouched by water
Even a person of the worst conduct, if he worships Me with undivided love, is to be counted among the righteous
One who knows Me as unborn, without beginning, the great Lord of the worlds, is freed from all sin
Goodness is pure and luminous, free from sin; it binds one only to happiness and knowledge
Give up all other supports and take refuge in Me alone; I shall free you from all sin, do not grieve
In whatever way people approach Me, in that same way do I receive them
For those who worship Me with undivided mind, I carry what they lack and guard what they have
Fix your mind on Me, take refuge in Me, and you will surely come to Me
Give up all other supports and take refuge in Me alone; I shall free you from all sin, do not grieve
Where Krishna is, and where the devoted archer stands, there is prosperity, victory and righteousness
Even the wise who strive may find the turbulent senses carrying the mind forcibly away
One who restrains the senses and rests the mind on Me is truly established in wisdom
As rivers enter the ocean without disturbing it, so desires enter one who is at peace; such a one attains peace
This divine illusion is hard to overcome, but those who take refuge in Me cross beyond it
Therefore arise, win glory, conquer your obstacles and enjoy a flourishing life
Better your own duty done imperfectly than another's done well; all work has some flaw, as fire has smoke
Where Krishna is, and where the devoted archer stands, there is prosperity, victory and righteousness
I am seated in the heart of all; from Me come memory, knowledge, and their fading away
The Lord dwells in the heart of every being, guiding all as they journey through this world
It is desire, it is anger, born of passion, all-devouring and never satisfied; know this to be your true enemy here
Therefore first master the senses, and slay this desire that destroys wisdom and realisation
Knowing the Self to be higher than the intellect, steady the mind by the Self and conquer this formidable enemy, desire
Pleasures born of sense contact are wombs of sorrow; they begin and they end, and the wise take no delight in them
Lust, anger and greed are the three gates to ruin, destroyers of the self; therefore give up these three
Lift yourself up by your own self; the self alone can be your friend, and the self alone your enemy
For one who has conquered the mind, it is the dearest friend; for one who has not, it remains the worst enemy
Whenever the restless, unsteady mind wanders away, bring it back and rest it in the Self
The mind is restless indeed, but it can be mastered through steady practice and detachment
